---
title: "ukhsa_data_analysis"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
antibiotic_use <- read_csv("ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(antibiotic_use))
```

I have selected antibiotic use in England


```{r}
ggplot(antibiotic_use, aes(
 x = date,
 y = metric_value
)) + geom_line(colour = "turquoise") + xlab("Date") + ylab("DID(Standard Consumption") + ggtitle("Rate of access antibiotics used in all care settings")
```
